import_legacy.title: Import your existing setup
import_legacy.description: This Home Assistant already has the integration configured under its previous name (OmniPlan). TaskDragon copied its lists, maintenance history and documents when it started. Import its people, schedule and Mealie connection too?

user.title: TaskDragon household
user.description: Choose the people in your household. They get personal "My Day" views, kiosk columns and shift-aware chores.

data.weather_entity: Weather entity (for "this weekend if it's not raining")
data.conversation_agent: Assist agent for Brain Dump (a local LLM works best)

data_description.conversation_agent: Leave empty to use the built-in rules parser.

shift.title: Work shifts: {person}
shift.description: Optionally link {person}'s work calendar. On days {person} works, shift-aware chores go to whoever is off duty (or whose shift ends first).

data.keywords: Shift keywords (comma separated; empty = every event is a shift)

mealie.title: Mealie (optional)
mealie.description: Connect a local Mealie server for prep timelines, leftovers and two-way shopping sync. Leave the URL empty to skip.

data.mealie_lookahead_days: Plan prep tasks this many days ahead

data_description.mealie_url: http:// or https:// address of your Mealie server, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:9000. No user names, query strings or redirects.
data_description.mealie_api_token: Stored in Home Assistant's config entry data and only ever sent to this Mealie server. It is never shown again or sent to dashboards.

data.rollover_hour: Daily rollover hour (recurring chores reset at this hour)
data.create_cook_tasks: Create a "Cook …" task for each planned meal
data.prep_rules: Prep rules (one per line: tag => hours | template)

data_description.prep_rules: Templates may use {recipe}, {meat} and {action}. Recipes tagged like thaw-36h work without a rule.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mealie at that URL within 10 seconds (redirects are not followed).
error.token_required: An API token is required when a Mealie URL is set.
error.invalid_url: Enter a plain http:// or https:// URL with a host name or IP address (no user name, query string or fragment).

shift.title: Work shifts: {person}
shift.description: Optionally link {person}'s work calendar for shift-aware chores.

data.keywords: Shift keywords (comma separated; empty = every event is a shift)

mealie.title: Mealie (optional)
mealie.description: Leave the URL empty to disconnect Mealie.

data.mealie_lookahead_days: Plan prep tasks this many days ahead

data_description.mealie_url: http:// or https:// address of your Mealie server, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:9000. No user names, query strings or redirects.
data_description.mealie_api_token: Leave empty to keep the stored token. It is never shown again or sent to dashboards.

data.create_cook_tasks: Create a "Cook …" task for each planned meal
data.prep_rules: Prep rules (one per line: tag => hours | template)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mealie at that URL within 10 seconds (redirects are not followed).
error.token_required: An API token is required when a Mealie URL is set.
error.invalid_url: Enter a plain http:// or https:// URL with a host name or IP address (no user name, query string or fragment).

parse_brain_dump.name: Parse brain dump
parse_brain_dump.description: Turn free text (or a voice transcript) into tasks and shopping items.

text.name: Text
text.description: What's on your mind, e.g. "pick up 2x4s Saturday morning and add garlic powder to the grocery list".

agent_id.name: Agent
agent_id.description: Assist conversation agent to use instead of the configured one.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only return the parsed actions without creating anything.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Create a task in an TaskDragon plan.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan name, id or its todo entity.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: none, low, medium, high or urgent.

assigned_to.name: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: Person entities; leave empty for the household pool.

shift_aware.name: Shift aware
shift_aware.description: Assign daily to whoever is off work.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task completed (or re-open it).

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: Exact task title, used when no uid is given.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Limit the summary search to this plan.

snooze_task.name: Snooze task
snooze_task.description: Hide a task until a time or a context is met.

rule_type.name: Rule
rule_type.description: time, person_home, all_home, weekend_dry or entity_state.

add_shopping_item.name: Add shopping item
add_shopping_item.description: Add an item to a shopping list, merging quantities with an existing entry.

trigger_pantry_low.name: Set pantry stock
trigger_pantry_low.description: Set a pantry item's stock and run its low-stock action.

action.name: Action
action.description: shopping, batch_task, ask or none (overrides the item setting).

sync_mealie.name: Sync Mealie
sync_mealie.description: Sync shopping lists and meal-plan prep tasks with Mealie now.

clone_plan.name: Clone plan
clone_plan.description: Duplicate a plan: its sections and every item that isn't part of a trip.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan name, id or its todo entity.

start_date.name: Due date
start_date.description: Optional due date for every copied item.

reset_plan.name: Reset plan
reset_plan.description: Un-check every item in a plan (all of its trips, for packing plans).

create_trip.name: Create trip
create_trip.description: Start a trip in a packing plan. Every item marked repeatable is copied onto it, unchecked.

plan.name: Packing plan
plan.description: Packing plan name, id or its todo entity.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day of the trip (defaults to the start date).

complete_maintenance.name: Complete maintenance task
complete_maintenance.description: Log a maintenance task as done: parts come out of stock, the next due date is scheduled and the task's on-complete action runs. Tasks that require an NFC scan can't be completed this way.

task.name: Task
task.description: Task id, its code (e.g. #3.1), "Object / Task" (e.g. Furnace / Replace Filter) or a task name that is unique.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Labor or service cost, on top of the parts used.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long it took, in minutes.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Shown in the task's history and the service record.

log_salt_level.name: Log water softener salt
log_salt_level.description: Record a salt fill, an observed level or an empty tank so the salt estimate recalibrates. A fill also completes the refill task.

kind.name: What happened
kind.description: fill, level (you looked at the tank) or empty (tank empty / bridges checked).

level.name: Level
level.description: Where the salt is now, on the softener's scale (level mark, percent or bags). For a fill, leave empty to mean full.

bags.name: Bags added
bags.description: For a fill: how many bags you poured in, instead of a level.

create_backup.name: Create portable backup
create_backup.description: Write an TaskDragon portable backup (.zip with the database, a JSON dump, documents and the standalone bridge map) to /config/backups/taskdragon and prune old snapshots. Administrators only.
